name: howto
title: Check a turkey in five steps
sub: USDA's temperature, ThermoWorks' ice-bath check, and the step people skip
footer: Sources: USDA FSIS safe temperature chart and turkey roasting guide (summaries read October 2026); ThermoWorks ice-bath guide. Follow your model's manual.

items.head: Ice-bath check first
items.body: Fill a glass with crushed ice, add water, stir, probe in the middle. Expect about 32 °F.

items.head: Probe the thigh
items.body: Push the tip into the innermost part of the thigh, not touching bone.

items.head: Probe the breast
items.body: Go into the thickest part of the breast, then the wing. All three need 165 °F.

items.head: Wait for the number
items.body: A one-second thermometer settles fast; a slower one needs 3–8 seconds. Do not read early.

items.head: Stuffing too
items.body: Stuffing in the cavity needs 165 °F in its centre as well.
